utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re thinking of helping, they could really use more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — I can help this afternoon. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Bo! Head over to the community shed by the park around two, and ask for Marla — she’ll point you to the sorting tables.

utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by soon to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Right now the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the porch. If you’re helping, I’ll send the details once the list of fixes is set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is the repair drive actually going well, Leo? I’d like a clear confirmation before I assume anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s going well so far, and I’m on it. If you need a clear update, I can check the repair area and tell you what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — then check it and tell me what’s left before I believe it’s all set.
